steps: ADMIT — monitor respiratory function (serial FVC) and autonomic status closely.
IVIG 0.4 g/kg/day ×5 days OR plasma exchange (equivalent efficacy).
ICU + ventilation if FVC falling, bulbar weakness or autonomic instability.
VTE prophylaxis, pain control, physiotherapy, pressure-area care.
Do NOT give corticosteroids (ineffective in GBS).

drugRefs.why: First-line immunotherapy — equivalent efficacy to plasma exchange and usually more practical. Corticosteroids are ineffective and should not be used.

refs: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 22e — Guillain-Barré Syndrome
AAN Practice Parameter — Immunotherapy for Guillain-Barré Syndrome

drugRefs.why: Immobile patients are at high venous-thromboembolism risk; give prophylactic LMWH unless contraindicated.

refs: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 22e — Guillain-Barré Syndrome

decision.label: IVIG or plasma exchange + close respiratory monitoring

confirm: Progressive ascending weakness with areflexia ± sensory/autonomic involvement, often post-infective; albuminocytological dissociation on CSF; supportive NCS.
